content.rationale: The file contains a `safeLink` function that explicitly validates URLs against `https:` protocol, `github.com` hostname, and absence of credentials before rendering an anchor tag. All other functions (`el`, `badge`, `duration`, `date`, `pretty`, `disclosure`, `fact`, `modelName`) construct DOM elements using safe methods (`createElement`, `textContent`, `append`) without injecting untrusted data into HTML attributes or event handlers. No evidence of unsafe external link injection exists.
